title: Coast Guard Crews Rescues 2 From Sinking Vessel Near Fishers Island
description: Crewmembers from Coast Guard Station New London aboard a 45-foot Response Boat-Medium approach a 55-foot fishing vessel taking on water near Fishers Island, New York, Sunday March 10, 2019. The individuals were picked up within one minute of abandoning ship. (Video courtesy of Station New London)
